== Background ==
Once at peace with the, the [[Decepticons]] sought conquest of power. Lead by the evil Megatron, they are natural enemies with the [[Autobots]] which a group lead by Optimus Prime. Having crashed on Earth, the [[Decepticons]] followed the [[Autobots]] to destroy their kind in order to achieve conquest.

== In game ==
The [[Decepticons]] are one of the four factions including Autobots, Decepticons, Maximals and Predacons.
